guideDisputes.a: PowerPyx and KeenGamer rate the platinum 4 out of 10 [2][10].
guideDisputes.call: 4 out of 10 for a player following this guide. The 7 counts the Master-tier shooting-range challenges, which are the only real skill wall.

guideDisputes.a: PowerPyx, KeenGamer and TimeSaver say about 200 hours to platinum [2][10][11].
guideDisputes.call: About 200 hours for a first-timer doing everything. 100 hours is the fast end, not the typical run.

guideDisputes.a: PowerPyx, KeenGamer and TimeSaver say there is 1 potentially missable trophy [2][10][11].
guideDisputes.call: 1 trophy is at risk: Positive Mental Attitude. The rest are collectibles and cash you can miss, not trophies.

missables.what: Meditate on Jason's balcony in Chapter 1. The only trophy with a possible missable attached.
missables.when: Chapter 1, before the point of no return

missables.item: Point of no return: starting "Tourist Trap"
missables.what: Kat's call after Recalibration starts a chain (Home Sweet Home, Discharge Time) with no free roam between. Chapter 2 starts broke.
Finish every task Shirley gives you: Get Shirley's Rum and Steal the Scooter (about $1,300 stash in the parrot cages).
Move at least $5,000 into BuckMe family savings. Family savings should be the only money that carries over.
Collect from Brian first — check the mailbox after Hey Arnold!
Enduro, Kayak and Retro Build. In-game text says they are for Chapter 1 only.
You cannot register cars until Moses in Chapter 2, so Chapter 1 uniques are easy to lose.
Race Against Yago (Chapter 3) and "This is a Free Call From..." expire if you ignore them. Do them the day they appear.
Choices shape the ending. Hey Arnold! is the first big one.
Beat the pool opponent in Chapter 2 before the Checking Out mission. The opponent is gone until the club reopens later.
Go into the Checking Out finale with at least $15,000 on hand so the safehouse stays yours.

missables.item: Magazines in Jason's house and story buildings
missables.what: Grab magazines while you can still enter those buildings.
Off limits for most of Chapter 2, returns in Chapter 3. Do the arcade trophies before or after, not during.
Permanent per character. Do not overdo the violence if you care about the profile tier.
Kenton vanishes after Chapter 1 and returns in Chapters 2-3. Calling Brian as Jason speeds his return.

roadmap.note: Story first. The only thing you can truly miss lives here: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation. Clear the Chapter 1 missables before Tourist Trap.
roadmap.title: Chapters 1-2: story first, trap the missable

roadmap.note: Side strands open: Andy, Randy and Tyrone in Chapter 3, Billy and Bret in Chapter 2. Start them early and finish before the finale.
roadmap.title: Chapters 2-3: side strands open

roadmap.note: The final mission sits here. Do the Chapter 4 vault mission (cafe wait) for two trophies, and finish both-character trophies before the finale.
roadmap.title: Chapter 4-5: finale approaches

roadmap.note: Free roam after the story. The 100% checklist, collectibles, races, shooting ranges and the five unconfirmed trophies all live here.
roadmap.title: After the story: cleanup and 100%

roadmap.note: The last trophy on the list. It pops the moment your other 54 are done.
roadmap.title: Platinum
